verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents an official MCP server built into its dg CLI that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs, and a probe confirms it on Deepgram's agentic-tools page, so an agent can connect through a first-party MCP server. Missing for 10: details of which tools or APIs the server exposes (including whether Voice Agent endpoints are covered), setup and transport documentation in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The dg CLI includes a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs.
